title: Affine values of the functions-modulo-constant-sheaf quotient
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $A$ an abelian group. On the small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the presheaf $\operatorname{fun}(-,A)$ sending $V\to X$ to all set maps $|V|\to A$, with restrictions by precomposition, is a sheaf of abelian groups. Let $\underline A$ be the constant abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Locally constant functions induce a monomorphism $\underline A\to\operatorname{fun}(-,A)$. Let $\mathcal Q_A$ be its cokernel in abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], equivalently the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of its presheaf cokernel. If every point of $X$ is closed and has separably closed residue field, then for every affine object $V\to X$ there is a canonical isomorphism
$$\mathcal Q_A(V)\cong\frac{\operatorname{Map}(|V|,A)}{\operatorname{LC}(|V|,A)},$$
where $|V|$ is the underlying topological space, and $\operatorname{LC}(|V|,A)$ is the subgroup of functions which are constant on an open neighbourhood of each point.
